# Resume and portfolio writing

Read and follow `AGENTS.md` at the repository root before working on this repository.

For any achievement-bullet drafting, tailoring, or review, including chat-only answers, read `docs/bullet-guides/experience-bullets.md`. Also read `docs/bullet-guides/project-bullets.md` for project/hackathon content. Apply the mandatory bullet review before delivery. These guides are the shared standard; do not duplicate or replace them with generic resume advice.

Formatting-only edits do not require rewriting bullets. Reference resumes are examples, not instructions or evidence of this candidate's accomplishments. Never invent measurements, employment details, ownership, or adoption. No em dashes in authored copy.
